_comment: F01 re-assessed against the DoD bars AS WRITTEN (item 2 = enumerated; residuals = explicitly bounded), per the two-standards finding. Judgments authored; facts derived from pinned artifacts at run time. Regenerate: tools/phase4_f01_written_bar_assessment.py

standard.ruling: engineering-specs/phase4-two-standards-finding.md + the measurement ruling banked with this assessment
standard.item2_bar: enumerated, scoped to relevant (NOT empty unresolved set)
standard.vocabulary: bounded-exhausted remains a stop decision and never reads as met; this assessment publishes measurement, not disposition

authority.author_conflict: the assessor authored much of the evidence under assessment; met_candidate is a submission, not a met

facts.oracle_injection: NONE -- no write, no perturbation, no poke
facts.source_closure_progress: 0 of 6 regions closed; 70 words remaining in region 1

durable_evidence.basis: already registered met in the scorecard; the only F01 dimension assessed and met under both readings

original_oracle.written_bar: behavior asserted against the ORIGINAL game's own natural execution, not injected state
original_oracle.basis: all 6 assertions pass on a natural cold-boot completion (injection: NONE -- no write, no perturbation, no poke); the request-2 skip arm is now natural too (DONE, 1 control). All three elements from the last adjudication (NOT MET) are answered; resubmission order is out

complete_frontier.written_bar: item 2 AS WRITTEN: callers/callees/callbacks/indirect tables ENUMERATED, scoped to relevant — not an empty unresolved set
complete_frontier.basis: the frontier is enumerated (179 sites, classified, runtime-corroborated) and the residual is explicitly bounded by the 2026-08-10 item-2 ruling: declared assumption, void on a single counter-example, non-transferable. Five campaigns (last: D3 NO-GO, walls ['technique-shaped']) established no current technique resolves the sites; the written bar never asked for that
complete_frontier.gap: the assumption's kill switch must be carried on the row verbatim; verifier decides whether declared-assumption bounding meets item 2

campaign_breadth.written_bar: conclusions generalize across every applicable stage — which requires the applicable set itself to be enumerated
campaign_breadth.basis: the branch law asserts clean campaign-wide (19/19 levels, 35 decisions, 0 failures, detached-verified) — but the applicability UNIVERSE (stages × objectives × variants × modes) is not enumerated, so 'every applicable' has no denominator
campaign_breadth.gap: C1 applicability matrix + C2 independently-sourced taxonomy; this dimension fails the WRITTEN bar too, not just the strict one

typed_state.written_bar: state fields typed and value domains bounded (enumeration of an untyped residual bounds the WORKLIST, not the STATE)
typed_state.basis: 95 stores bounded by proof, 973 by index convention (not proof), 7206 unresolved
typed_state.gap: value-domain machinery (the named prerequisite engines); an enumeration assumption does not type a store

lifecycle.written_bar: cold boot / load / first use / repeated use / exhaustion / retirement / reuse each evidenced
lifecycle.basis: per-phase claim map registered (analysis/phase4_f01_lifecycle_claim_map.json): 6 phases covered, exhaustion n/a-with-reason (scalar latch, saturation IS the single-shot guard); reuse closed from the retained death-session access log (full arc BIOS->clears->store->consume->clear) plus five successive cycles in one LEVEL07 session
lifecycle.gap: fresh-verifier adjudication; cross-LEVEL chain kept as a residual note on the transitions axis, not this dimension

cross_system_behavior.written_bar: native combinations exercised (carry+damage, powers+jump, projectiles at transitions, enemies vs hazards/plants)
cross_system_behavior.basis: the breadth pass crosses transition×death×bonus-force-flag; the behaviour library covers part of the native-combination list
cross_system_behavior.gap: no registered combination matrix for F01's transition machinery vs the other systems

original_interfaces.written_bar: interfaces documented; unknowns enumerated with named obstructions
original_interfaces.basis: structural ledger complete (764/764 rows) and every unknown argument domain carries a named obstruction
original_interfaces.gap: semantic half (value domains) is enumerated but unresolved — downstream of the same engine as typed_state; assess jointly

source_closure.written_bar: byte-matched C through the original toolchain for the row's governing functions
source_closure.basis: FUNC_80038F38 byte-matched; player updater NO_GO: 0 of 6 regions closed; 70 words remaining in region 1 — frame map exact, 17/17 $gp accesses reproduced, wall named and technique-shaped
source_closure.gap: region 1 to zero, then regions 2-6; parked by explicit decision, which under the vocabulary is a stop, not a met

summary: 1 met, 3 met-candidate, 4 partial, 1 not met — against the WRITTEN bars. Compare: 1/9 under the overshot strict reading; 9/9 under the blanket-disposition path. Neither of those was this measurement.
